title: OD and GFP Plate Reader Assay (72 h Measurement)
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8aihsce

steps.title: Prepare and autoclave media
steps.instruction: Prepare and autoclave the following media according to standard procedures: M9TG Media (Without carbon source), M9TG Media (0.5% Glycerol), M9TG Media (2% Glycerol), and M9TG Media (0.5% Succinate and 1mM Leucine).

steps.title: Configure BioTek Synergy MX Microplate Reader
steps.instruction: Set the following variables for the BioTek Synergy MX Microplate Reader:

substeps.instruction: Set temperature setpoint to 37°C and preheat.
Set Kinetic run to 72:00:00 with an interval of 0:04:20.
Set OD600 read: Absorbance Endpoint of full plate, Wavelength 600, Read Speed Normal.
Set GFP read: Fluorescence Endpoint of full plate, Filter Set Excitation 488/9,0, Emission 510/9,0, Optics Bottom, Gain 100, Read Speed Normal.

steps.title: Grow bacteria overnight
steps.instruction: Grow desired bacteria overnight at 37°C and 250 RPM in a 50 ml falcon tube containing 10 mL M9TG media (or Luria-Bertani media).

substeps.instruction: If LB media was used, wash cells with PBS buffer: spin cells down at 4700 x G for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 10 ml PBS.
Repeat the spin and resuspension in PBS a second time.

steps.title: Load 96-well plate
steps.instruction: Load the 96-well plate with the corresponding buffer and overnight culture.

substeps.instruction: Add 190 µL of the corresponding buffer to the wells.
Add 10 µL of overnight culture (amounts based on an OD ~0.3; adjust based on actual OD).
Ensure washing steps are performed if cells were grown in LB media.

steps.title: Process and analyze data
steps.instruction: Retrieve data from the computer and perform necessary corrections.

substeps.instruction: Subtract the autofluorescence from the control sample from all other samples.
